document.title: Estimated Tax for Individuals
document.copies_are_distinct: Four vouchers print per year and each is its own payment, so four of one amount are four payments — never one figure reported four times (spec 079 FR-005).

boxes.label: Amount of estimated tax you are paying by check or money order
Payment Voucher
boxes.note: Which of the four vouchers (1-4); with the due date it is what tells four payments of one amount apart.

boxes.label: Calendar year—Due
boxes.note: The voucher's printed due date (Apr. 15, June 16, Sept. 15 2025, Jan. 15 2026).

boxes.label: 2025 Estimated Tax
boxes.note: The year the payment is for - a voucher for another year is not a 2025 payment.

boxes.label: (b) Date paid
boxes.note: Record of Estimated Tax Payments - the taxpayer's own page, one row per payment 1-4.

boxes.label: (c) Check or money order number, or credit or debit card confirmation number
(d) Amount paid (do not include any convenience fee)
(f) Total amount paid and credited (add (d) and (e))

document.notes: There is no information return for estimated payments. The figure is the taxpayer's own record of four vouchers, reconcilable against an IRS account transcript.

face_not_boxes.because: A line of the 2025 Estimated Tax Worksheet (or the instructions' numbered text) the taxpayer works through to SIZE a payment; the vouchers and the payment record are what was paid, and a worksheet line is never a figure the sheet reads.

extraction.note: Azure ships no prebuilt-tax model for this form, so it reached the generic reader - which emits no field bearing these box names, so every cited route out of this document was dead while looking implemented (spec 075 US1/W42). Read by the declared custom model: a voucher's amount, number, due date and year, and - where the client keeps it - the Record of Estimated Tax Payments page.

custom.reads: an estimated-tax payment voucher. Four print per year; each voucher is its own document and carries its own due date. Or the taxpayer's Record of Estimated Tax Payments page.
